COUNT_TOTAL.definition: Calculates the total number of distinct entities in a group.
COUNT_TOTAL.requirements: Requires a list of entities. No specific numerical data needed.
unacceptable_if: The group name already specifies the count (e.g., 'The 5 highest-grossing...').
The count is a fixed-domain constant (e.g., 'Starting players in a volleyball match' is always 6).

good_examples.input_group: Aircraft types in the fleet of Western Airlines as of 1986.
good_examples.output: How many different types of aircraft made up the Western Airlines fleet in 1986?

good_examples.input_group: Diplomatic missions of Romania located in African countries.
good_examples.output: How many total diplomatic missions, including embassies and consulates, does Romania maintain across the African continent?

good_examples.input_group: Current members of the Atlanta Rhythm Section.
good_examples.output: How many musicians are currently recognized as official members of the Atlanta Rhythm Section?

bad_examples.input_group: The 10 largest companies in Malaysia for 2024.
bad_examples.reason: Redundancy: The group name 'The 10 largest' already provides the count.

bad_examples.input_group: Starting positions for the Canada men's national basketball team.
bad_examples.reason: Fixed-Domain: A standard basketball depth chart always has 5 starting positions.

UNIQUE_DIVERSITY.definition: Counts unique categories when multiple entities share the same attribute.
UNIQUE_DIVERSITY.requirements: Requires a categorical column with repeating values.
unacceptable_if: Every row has a unique value in the category column (no diversity to measure).

good_examples.output: How many distinct industrial sectors are represented in Punjab's manufacturing data for 2017?

good_examples.input_group: Awards and nominations received by Tulus at Anugerah Planet Muzik.
good_examples.output: How many different types of award categories has Tulus been recognized in at the Anugerah Planet Muzik?

good_examples.input_group: Leadership positions in the 78th West Virginia Senate.
good_examples.output: How many different political parties are represented among the leadership of the 78th West Virginia Senate?

bad_examples.input_group: List of distinct passport numbers for Romanian diplomats.
bad_examples.reason: Every passport number is unique by definition; there is no shared category diversity.

bad_examples.input_group: Names of residential halls at Daffodil International University.
bad_examples.reason: If every hall has a unique name and no other categorical column (like 'Gender' or 'Capacity') repeats, it is just a COUNT_TOTAL.

FILTER_COUNT_RANGE.definition: Counts entities that fall within a numerical/temporal threshold.
FILTER_COUNT_RANGE.requirements: MUST have numerical (Integers/Floats) or temporal (Years/Dates) data.
unacceptable_if: No numerical or date-based columns exist.

good_examples.input_group: Box office performance of South Korean films in 2001.
good_examples.output: How many South Korean films released in 2001 surpassed one million total admissions?
In how many manufacturing sectors in Punjab were there more than 1,000 workers employed in 2017?

good_examples.input_group: BMI London Awards received by Drake.
good_examples.output: How many BMI London Awards did Drake receive between the years 2016 and 2018?

bad_examples.input_group: Residential halls at Daffodil University.
bad_examples.reason: No numerical values exist to define a 'range'.

bad_examples.input_group: Positions of Romanian players in Davis Cup.
bad_examples.reason: Player positions (e.g., 'Singles') are categorical, not range-based.

EXTREME_NUMERICAL.definition: Identifies the entity with the highest or lowest numeric value.
EXTREME_NUMERICAL.requirements: MUST have a numerical column (Revenue, Goals, Height).
unacceptable_if: Numerical data represents non-comparable IDs (e.g., Zip codes).

good_examples.output: Which Kannada film released in 1992 achieved the highest total box office collection?

good_examples.input_group: Top scorers for Hull City A.F.C. 2011-12.
good_examples.output: Who was the leading goal scorer for Hull City A.F.C. during the 2011–12 season?
Which Malaysian company reported the highest revenue in billions of US dollars for the year 2024?

bad_examples.input_group: Members of the 78th West Virginia Senate.
bad_examples.reason: Phone numbers are numbers, but finding the 'highest' phone number is illogical.

bad_examples.input_group: Cities served by Libyan Wings.
bad_examples.reason: No numerical magnitude data (like population or distance) is available.

COMPARATIVE_DIFFERENCE.definition: Calculates the gap between two specific entities.
COMPARATIVE_DIFFERENCE.requirements: MUST have a numerical column and at least two distinct entities.

good_examples.output: What is the percentage difference in viewing share between Imedi TV and Rustavi 2?
By how many tonnes does the production of Silver exceed that of Gold in the State of Hidalgo?
What is the numerical difference in GPA value between a letter grade of 'A' and a letter grade of 'B'?

bad_examples.input_group: Green Bay Packers NFL championships.
bad_examples.reason: Comparing 'Years' as a difference is usually less meaningful than comparing scores or stats.

bad_examples.input_group: List of Species in the family Partulidae.
bad_examples.reason: No numerical values exist to perform a subtraction.

GROUPED_LOOKUP.definition: Filters by Category A to find/count a specific value in Column B.
GROUPED_LOOKUP.requirements: Requires multiple columns (typically two categorical or one cat/one num).

good_examples.output: Among the aircraft manufactured by Boeing, how many different models were in service with Western Airlines in 1986?
How many accolades has Bae Suzy received specifically from the KBS organization?
Which of the private unaided schools are located specifically within the Muvattupuzha Educational District?

bad_examples.input_group: Single record of a university authority member.
bad_examples.reason: With only one row or one specific person, there is no group to 'filter' through.

bad_examples.input_group: List of extinct snails.
bad_examples.reason: If only 'Species Name' is provided without 'Region' or 'Year', you cannot perform a grouped lookup.

EXTREME_TEMPORAL.definition: Identifies the earliest or latest entity based on dates.
EXTREME_TEMPORAL.requirements: MUST have a temporal column (Years, Dates).

good_examples.output: Which country was the first to host an international location of The Pizza Company?
Who was the earliest appointed Austro-Hungarian ambassador to Spain according to the records from 1867 to 1918?

good_examples.input_group: Films directed by J. P. Dutta.
good_examples.output: What is the name of the most recent film produced or directed by J. P. Dutta listed in the data?

bad_examples.input_group: Languages spoken in Florida.
bad_examples.reason: This is a census snapshot; there is no timeline or 'earliest' language date.

bad_examples.input_group: Members of the Atlanta Rhythm Section.
bad_examples.reason: If 'Join Date' is missing, a temporal question cannot be asked.

TOP_K_RANKING.definition: Identifies the top $K$ entities based on a numeric rank.
TOP_K_RANKING.requirements: MUST have a numerical column to sort by.

good_examples.output: Based on total box office collection, what were the three most successful Kannada films released in 1992?

good_examples.input_group: Most viewed TV channels in Georgia.
good_examples.output: What are the five most watched television channels in Georgia based on their viewing share during the New Year period?
Excluding English, what are the top three languages spoken in Florida according to the 2010 census?

bad_examples.input_group: List of Romanian Davis Cup players.
bad_examples.reason: No performance ranking is provided; it's just a roster.

bad_examples.input_group: Residential halls at a university.
bad_examples.reason: No numerical metric (size, age, cost) to rank 'Top' halls.

AGGREGATION.definition: Calculates a Sum or Average across a numerical column.
AGGREGATION.requirements: MUST have numerical data where math is logical (Revenue, Workers, Goals).

good_examples.output: What is the total number of workers employed across all registered manufacturing industries in Punjab?
What is the average volume of mineral production per site in the State of Hidalgo?
What is the combined revenue of the top ten largest companies in Malaysia for 2024?

bad_examples.input_group: Years of high jump competitions.
bad_examples.reason: Summing or averaging years (2016 + 2017) is mathematically meaningless.

bad_examples.input_group: GPA values for grades.
bad_examples.reason: Averaging the GPA scale itself (4.0, 3.0, 2.0) doesn't provide insight into student performance.

FREQUENCY_MODE.definition: Identifies the most common category (The Mode).
FREQUENCY_MODE.requirements: Requires a categorical column with repeating values.

good_examples.output: What is the most common musical role or instrument held by members of the Atlanta Rhythm Section?
In which specific year did Drake receive the highest number of BMI London Awards?
What was the most frequent final status (e.g., relegated or stayed) for clubs in the 2006–07 Football League One?

bad_examples.input_group: List of unique films by J. P. Dutta.
bad_examples.reason: If every film is listed once and there are no repeating categories, there is no 'mode'.

bad_examples.input_group: Members of the Plano City Council.
bad_examples.reason: If every member has a unique 'Place' and 'Name', no frequency exists.
